events.title: Beers + Maintenance | Trailside Tune Up
events.description: Hands-on clinic for all skill levels. Learn to handle skipping/lagging shifting, chain issues, rubbing brakes, and valve core problems. Participants will observe demonstrations and practice. Drink token and small snack provided. For all women 18 or older.

events.title: Test + Tune with Cane Creek Components (Again)
events.description: Suspension test and tune with industry experts from Cane Creek Components. For riders with suspension bikes comfortable on rocky/rooty downhill trails. Meet at Explorer Loop parking lot. No e-bikes allowed. For all women 18 or older. Limited to 8 spots via waitlist.

events.title: November Group Ride + Social
events.description: Riding at Pisgah and DuPont. No e-bikes allowed at either location. Post-ride social at Oskar Blues Brewery (342 Mountain Industrial Dr, Brevard, NC 28712). For all women 18 and older.

events.title: December Group Ride + Social
events.description: Riding in Hot Springs. No e-bikes allowed. Post-ride social at Big Pillow Brewing (25-27 N Andrews Avenue, Hot Springs, NC 28743-9231). For all women 18 and older.
